name: Hail of Darts

source.title: Pathfinder One-Shot #4: Mark of the Mantis

disable: Thievery (expert) on the floor tile or wall socket

items.name: Darts
items.text:
Trigger Pressure is applied to the floor tile

---

Effect The trap shoots darts, making an attack against each creature in a 30-foot line centered on the floor tile.

items.name: Old Giant Wasp Venom
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 22 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

---

Stage 1 2d6 poison damage and Clumsy 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 3d6 poison damage and Clumsy 2 (1 round)

Stage 3 4d6 poison damage and clumsy 2 (1 round).

text: An array of spring-loaded, ceiling-mounted darts are primed to fire down into the hallway when triggered by a pressure plate.
